summary: Frontend regression verified for the 4 requested changes on EcoAndes. Button centering, per-product tech sheet PDFs (5 SKUs), reviews list w/ 5-visible + toggle, mobile bottom nav Heart->Store swap, and login regression all pass.

issues: Toggle label renders as 'SEE ALL REVIEWS (N)' in uppercase due to text-transform; consistent with site button style, likely intentional.

critical_code_review_comments: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' inside TrafficMap svg render (Admin dashboard). Non-blocking but should be fixed by adding key props to mapped SVG children.

Shop page renders 432 product-card testids for 174 products (variants each get a card testid). Only currently-rendered cards show rating; consider deduping data-testids per product-slug or ensuring rating renders on all variants for consistency.
